summary:
Implementation plan for TraceXMail security remediation, SQL schema bug fixes, ML reporting recalculation, and static route cleanup.
- Rotates plaintext credentials in data/org_users.json to unique bcrypt hashes and removes clearPassword everywhere.
- Gitignores .gmail_connection.json and org_users.json; relocates test fixtures to os.tmpdir().
- Fixes idx_intel_cache_provider_key column mismatch in schema_extensions.sql and expands cases.status CHECK constraint in schema.sql.
- Resolves ML 5-class stratified cross-validation sampling bug, recalculates AUC-ROC and R-Squared, and corrects feature polarities for meta-classifier.
- Cleans placeholder GA/AdSense tags in index.html, updates vercel.json rewrites for /about and /knowledge, and repairs truncated tor-exit-list.txt.
